scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a short chance to add a no-cost bilingual board-book pickup code to an already planned toddler supply run.
Emerging Need: The benefit is optional and only becomes sensible after the qualifying purchase, store add-on notice, and saved privacy boundary line up.
Decision Context: Calendar, message, wallet, and email records establish the outing context, receipt eligibility, claim route, and cutoff; the stored coordination note supplies consent limits and the public pickup label.
Consequence: Timely coordination could turn an ordinary supply receipt into a small extra for the twins, while inaction leaves the supplies and reimbursements unchanged after codes close.

parameter.subject: Same-day Fiesta Read-Aloud receipt add-on
parameter.body: Fiesta Read-Aloud add-on: Today only, H-E-B baby-care purchases over $20 can claim one no-cost bilingual board-book pickup code. Email the receipt reference and a public pickup label to communitydesk@heb.example by 13:30 today. No extra purchase or phone number is required; unclaimed codes return to the community desk pool.

parameter.body: The 13:30 email claim window has closed, and remaining board-book pickup codes have been assigned from the community desk pool. Existing baby-care purchases and regular receipts are unchanged.
